successCriteria.description: src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports a LeaveRequest entity whose fields are exactly id: string, employeeId: string, leaveType: LeaveType, startDate: Date, endDate: Date, reason: string | undefined, status: LeaveStatus, approvedBy: string | null, approvedAt: Date | null, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date — with LeaveType/LeaveStatus imported from src/shared/types.

src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts exports ILeaveRequestRepository and LeaveRequestRepository exposing create, findById, findByEmployee, findByStatus, findByQuery, update, updateStatus, and delete.
create persists a leave_requests row via parameterized SQL and returns the mapped entity with status PENDING, approvedBy null, approvedAt null, and a generated id/createdAt/updatedAt.

updateStatus persists the new LeaveStatus and returns the updated entity; when the target status is APPROVED/REJECTED it stamps approvedBy and approvedAt, and throws LeaveNotFoundError (code LEAVE_NOT_FOUND) when no row matches.
update builds a dynamic SET clause from only the supplied fields, always sets updated_at, and throws LeaveNotFoundError when no row matches.
findById returns the mapped LeaveRequest or null when absent; findByEmployee/findByStatus/findByQuery return mapped arrays filtered by their respective criteria.

constraints: All SQL must be raw pg parameterized SQL against the shared pool (src/shared/db/connection.ts); Knex must not be used in repository queries.

Write methods (create, update, updateStatus, delete) accept an optional PoolClient as their LAST parameter and default to the shared pool via `const conn: Pool | PoolClient = client ?? pool`; read methods always use the shared pool.
IDs are generated with randomUUID from 'crypto'; createdAt/updatedAt are set to `new Date()` by the repository and never caller-supplied.

RepositoryError and UniqueConstraintError must be imported from the employee module's public entry point (src/modules/employee/index.ts), not re-declared; a local LeaveNotFoundError (code LEAVE_NOT_FOUND) extends RepositoryError.
pg unique-violation (code 23505) must be detected via an isPgError/isPgUniqueViolation guard and mapped to UniqueConstraintError; no `any` type (use unknown + type guards).
Only leave.model.ts and leave.repository.ts are created in this sub-phase; no leave.service.ts, no tests, no module index.ts.
outOfScope: Leave controller, routes, and API-boundary validation — Phase 9.
Business-rule enforcement (startDate<=endDate, active-policy check, balance deduction, audit writes, RBAC) — owned by the service/controller phases, not the repository.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest is created as PENDING immediately (no DRAFT/SUBMITTED state); approvedBy and approvedAt are null until the request is approved or rejected, and remain null for PENDING/CANCELLED.

Lifecycle state machine: PENDING → (APPROVED | REJECTED); PENDING → CANCELLED (owner only); APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED are terminal. The repository persists status transitions but does not itself enforce the transition legality (service owns that).
leaveType is stored as the LeaveType enum string value (not a FK to leave_policies); reason maps to NULL when undefined; approvedBy/approvedAt map to NULL when null.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Persists a new leave_requests row and returns the mapped LeaveRequest; maps pg 23505 to UniqueConstraintError; defaults status to PENDING and approvedBy/approvedAt to null.
Returns the mapped LeaveRequest or null when no row matches; never throws for a missing row.
Returns an array (possibly empty) of mapped LeaveRequests for the given employeeId.
Returns an array (possibly empty) of mapped LeaveRequests matching the given LeaveStatus.
Returns an array (possibly empty) of mapped LeaveRequests filtered by the supplied query criteria (status/leaveType/date ranges/limit/offset).
Applies only the supplied fields, always sets updated_at, returns the updated entity, and throws LeaveNotFoundError (code LEAVE_NOT_FOUND) when no row matches.
Persists the new status (and stamps approvedBy/approvedAt for APPROVED/REJECTED), returns the updated entity, and throws LeaveNotFoundError when no row matches.
Removes the matching leave_requests row and throws LeaveNotFoundError when no row matches.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: LeaveRequest entity fields and their snake_case column mappings must match the canonical leave_requests table (id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at) as defined in the reconciled architecture.
LeaveType and LeaveStatus enums must be imported from the shared types module (values annual/sick/emergency/unpaid/maternity/paternity and PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED), not re-declared.
The shared pg Pool must be imported from the shared-db public entry point and used as the default connection for all repository queries.
RepositoryError and UniqueConstraintError must be imported from the employee module's public entry point (not re-declared), matching how policy/balance/notification reuse them.
Row-mapping convention (LEAVE_COLUMNS constant, snake_case LeaveRequestRow interface, mapRow() to camelCase) must mirror the sibling repository modules.
Dynamic SET-clause update pattern (only supplied fields + always updated_at + not-found throw) must match the sibling update implementations.

integrationPoints.why: Entity field types for leaveType and status.
Default connection for all repository queries.
Shared typed error base classes reused by the leave repository.
